audit.proof_assessment: No proof artifacts were supplied; review is from the allowlisted diff only. route.ts prefixes projectId iff the parsed run ID does not already start with [A-Za-z0-9], leaves already-legal IDs unchanged, and still echoes parsedRunId.data as response runId. The new test drives real POST with literal -abc1 and _abc1 and asserts HTTP 200, original runId, proposal teammateId, and receipt.status complete. Auth still gates before params/body; assignment and GET paths are untouched.
residual_risks: Constant prefix run- aliases distinct external run IDs onto one internal projectId (e.g. -abc1 vs run--abc1) if the job hash includes projectId; not observable in the HTTP body.
Shared maxLength between runId and projectId is untested; a max-length dash/underscore-leading run ID could still fail job schema after prefixing.
Tests never spy on executeAiTeammateJobV1, so always-prefixing already-legal IDs would still pass the mandated oracle.
